statement: Quest landing never commits source bytes that are not covered by a recorded source attempt: land refuses (typed BLOCKED, never verdict not-required) whenever any staged or working-tree path outside solve/ differs from the base commit but is absent from the recorded attempt union, and a refused attempt record (for example a scope-pressure blocked-scope gate-decision) with pending source bytes leaves the candidate un-landable until an attempt is honestly recorded and independently verified; the scope-safe commit is derived only from the recorded union, and a green doneWhen receipt alone never authorizes a source landing. Proven deterministically on the real landing preflight and commit path (test/solve) with the exact sequence that produced ce0e4942d on 2026-08-30 (receipt already green, attempt record refused by the scope guard, land run): red on HEAD (land commits the staged source with verdict not-required), green after (land blocks with a typed problem naming the uncovered paths; recording the attempt and a verifier approval then lands exactly the union).

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

The landing owner (scripts/solve/operator-workflow.js land path, landing-preflight, handoff scope computation) stays the sole authority for what a landing commits; no caller, checkpoint, or evidence ingest may widen the committed set beyond the recorded attempt union.

An uncovered source path is a typed BLOCKED problem naming the paths, never a silent verdict not-required and never an automatic attempt record; evidence-only quests (no source delta) keep their current not-required landing.

Reproduce the 2026-08-30 sequence (green receipt, attempt record refused by the scope guard, land) on the real landing path in test/solve with a temporary git repository fixture; red on HEAD, green after.
